title: NBE Sensitivity & Ablation Study

environment.neo4j: same live orphaned-container process established in Phase 21; not restarted this phase

baseline_reproduction.note: Ablation A's re-weighting exactly reproduces score_action()'s real, live-collected value across all 3 campaigns x 8 steps x all candidates.

C_no_model_probability.description: identical operation to B - model probability has exactly one channel into the formula, via uncertainty_reduction

ranking_metrics.kendall_tau_undefined_reason: step 8 has exactly 1 remaining candidate; tau undefined for n=1; occurs for all 8 ablations x 3 pairs = 24

root_cause_chain: mitre_knowledge is always the highest-static-score action (1.74) on an empty store, so it is always taken at step 1 in every campaign
evidence/collectors/mitre_collector.py never sets Evidence.relevance -> stays at dataclass default 0.0
EvidenceStore.weighted_confidence() and evidence_coverage() both give zero weight to relevance=0.0 evidence (deliberate anti-saturation design)
=> evidence_reliability=0.0 and evidence_coverage=0.0 after step 1, in every campaign, unconditionally
=> investigation_confidence=0.0, uncertainty=1.0 when XGBOOST_PREDICTION is scored at step 2
=> uncertainty_reduction for xgboost is pinned to exactly 1.0 regardless of real campaign content
xgboost_specific_test.h1_magnitude_dominance_hypothesis: FALSIFIED - ablations F1/F2/F3 isolate each adaptive term individually and still show zero cross-campaign variance
xgboost_specific_test.h2_no_content_channel_hypothesis: CONFIRMED - novelty and redundancy_penalty are functions of the action-type sequence only, not evidence content; the sequence is itself deterministic given the formula

classification_reasoning: Not just ranking invariance with varying scores underneath - the raw scores themselves show literally zero cross-campaign variance in all 192 comparisons across 8 independent scoring configurations, including 3 that isolate individual nominally-adaptive terms.

test_suite.new_tests_purpose: validate the ablation-formula reproduction and the ranking/divergence-detection logic itself, not new production behavior

reproducibility.dataset: live neo4j-soc campaigns CAMP_427A075C, CAMP_1429ADB4, CAMP_D8605E81
reproducibility.note: Working tree also carries uncommitted Phase 20+/21 investigation-module changes already present before this phase; exact re-run requires that same uncommitted state, not just the base commit.

conclusion: The NBE ranking formula, as currently implemented, converts only action-sequence state (which action types have run) into ranking variation, not evidence content or investigation-specific model/uncertainty state, for 7 of its 8 candidate actions. The 8th (XGBoost) has exactly one content-sensitive channel, which is structurally pinned to a constant value at the only point it is ever evaluated, given the always-identical first action. This is a code-level, ablation-confirmed explanation for Phase 21's observed ranking invariance, not a contradiction of it.
recommended_phase_23_direction: NOT IMPLEMENTED. If adaptive ranking is a goal, the NBE formula would need at least one term that reads Evidence.confidence/Evidence.relevance VALUES (not just source-touched booleans) into scoring - e.g., an information-gain term computed from the actual relevance/confidence distribution gathered so far, not merely whether a source category has been visited. Any such redesign should be scoped as its own phase, justified directly by this study's failure-mode finding, and validated against real data the same way this phase was - not assumed to fix the problem without re-testing.
